lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y12Ti12C12 (reduced formula YTiC) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 143), with 36 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows carbon centers with 10 geometric neighbors (6 Ti, 4 Y) and titanium centers with 11 neighbors (4 C, 7 Y), while yttrium centers have 13 neighbors (6 C, 7 Ti). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between C and Ti polyhedra, as well as edge- and corner/face-sharing among Y polyhedra.
